dog.description_text:
My foster writes: Meet Diva, the pup who has the best personality! Sweet, observant, and wonderfully easygoing, Diva would be perfect for someone looking for a calm companion who is loving but also independent. Diva loves being part of your day. Compared to toys, Diva put all her attention to people. She will follow you from room to room, check in on what you are doing, and then settle into her own spot for a nap. When craving for human food, she likes to sit nearby and watch every bite with hopeful eyes, but she is never demanding. When you come home, she will greet you with enthusiastic tail wags, tiny happy whines, and plenty of affection. She rarely makes a sound, but she is an excellent communicator-she is an expert of using her body language to express her needs. She learned "paw" in only two days, so there is more potential to explore!

Update 11/15: Diva is such a sweetheart! Everyone that has met her thought she is a puppy under 3 years old, and would not believe that she is actually 9. She greets people on the street and enjoys being rubbed on the butt. Diva's strong tail is a signature sign of her because she is constantly happy and paying attention to what people are doing. She is also a big foodie for snacks. She has such an amazing manner that she can just patiently and quietly watch you eat for a long time until her turn. When she is outside, she is all focused on exploring the nature. Despite her age, she does not like to stop at one spot too long, and always excited about going forward. Diva has no interest in chewing (even with snacks) toys, so people do not have to worry about their furniture and shoes at all! Diva will let you know when she needs to pee in the morning by whining by your bed. She also greets you by whining excitedly when you come home. She is very comfortable staying home by herself sleeping all day, and she is used to go bathroom outside.
dog.name: Diva
